quotes.text: Sed res est certissima exactissimaque, quod proportio quae est inter binorum quorumcunque Planetarum tempora periodica, sit praecise sesquialtera proportionis mediarum distantiarum
quotes.tr: But it is most certain and most exact that the ratio between the periodic times of any two planets is precisely the sesquialterate (the 3/2 power) of the ratio of their mean distances.
quotes.tr_panel: Most certain, most exact: periods go precisely as the 3/2 power of the distances.
quotes.tr_short: Most certain, most exact: periods go precisely as the 3/2 power of the distances.
quotes.note: Book V ch. III, p. 189 (sentence runs on to p. 190 with 'id est Orbium ipsorum'). 'sesquialtera proportio' = ratio to the 3/2 power. Box coordinates from pdftotext -bbox on the Commons PDF (page 281), x 4.167 px/pt, checked by eye.
